title: One Open Prairie Ridge Membership per Person
content:
**Clause.** A person holds at most 1 Medicaid Managed Care Membership with Prairie Ridge at a time. A second enrollment is never opened alongside an open one, and the state enrollment file is the only source that opens a membership. A new membership is created only when the person has no other membership in pending, active, renewal due, reconsideration or suspended status. A terminated membership does not block a new enrollment spell; the new spell is opened as a new membership rather than by reopening the old one.

## Basis of the judgement

- **Whose record decides.** The person's existing memberships as the system records them, and the status each one holds, decide the question before any new membership is created. What the caller says about an earlier membership does not replace that record.
- **Which object is compared.** Memberships are compared for the same person; memberships of other family members are not part of the comparison.
- **Who opens a membership.** Only the state enrollment file opens one. Each enrollment spell is its own membership, distinguished by its enrollment date.

## Status of an existing membership and its effect on a new enrollment

| Status of the person's existing membership | Counts as open | A new membership may be created from the state file |
|---|---|---|
| Pending | Yes | No |
| Active | Yes | No |
| Renewal due | Yes | No |
| Reconsideration | Yes | No |
| Suspended | Yes | No |
| Terminated | No | Yes, as a new membership; the terminated one is not reopened |

## Hypothetical cases

*Hypothetical records, for illustration only.*

1. A person's only membership ended last year and shows terminated. A new state enrollment opens a new membership with its own enrollment date; the old membership stays terminated.
2. A person's membership is in reconsideration after a procedural coverage end. A new enrollment is not opened alongside it, because reconsideration is an open status.
3. A person holds one suspended membership. The suspended membership counts as open, so a second membership is not created.
